name: Lian Twining
original_name: ライアン トワイニング
source:
Name: Lien Twining
Sex: Male
Age: 22 (Past) | 28 (Present)
Birthday: May 18
Profession: Unemployed (Past), Locksmith (Present)
Likes: ALFREE, Yoyagi Park, Kizzy
Dislikes: The Past, Anything Kizzy Dislikes
Hobbies: Building Model Planes and Spaceships
Skills: Extraordinary Lockpicking Ability

[Past]
A former thief. Until recently, he was working as a janitor but was fired due to his past... He fell in love with Kizuna Chieda after seeing her dance at Matsushita Diner. He gets rejected after confessing his love to her.
[Present]
A former thief who now works as a locksmith. His feelings for Kizuna haven't changed. [spoiler]He still regrets not being able to protect her 6 years ago...[/spoiler]

[From the in-game character descriptions]
